text:
Predicates:
Roses(x) ::: x is a rose.
GivenOutOnTV(x) ::: x is given out on TV.
OnMondayAt8PM(x) ::: x is given out on TV on some Mondays at 8 pm.
Bachelor(x) ::: x is on the Bachelor.
PortraysLivesOfRealPeople(x) ::: x portrays the lives of real people.
RealityTVShow(x) ::: x is a reality TV show.
BreakingBad ::: Breaking Bad (as a specific show).
Premises:
∀x (GivenOutOnTV(x) → Roses(x)) ::: On some Mondays at 8 pm, roses are given out on TV.
∀x (GivenOutOnTV(x) → Bachelor(x)) ::: Every rose given out on TV is on the Bachelor.
∀x (PortraysLivesOfRealPeople(x) → RealityTVShow(x)) ::: Everything portraying the lives of real people are reality TV shows.
¬RealityTVShow(BreakingBad) ::: Breaking Bad is not a reality TV show.
Conclusion:
∀x (GivenOutOnTV(x) ∧ Roses(x) ∧ OnMondayAt8PM(x) → BreakingBad) ::: If roses are given out during Breaking Bad, then it is on Monday at 8 pm.
